 Puducherry, Andhra win in Group C
 By: Agencies 
 Date:
 November 15, 2026 
 Share post:
 WhatsApp Facebook X ReddIt Telegram Linkedin 
 GROUP C 
 Mohali, Nov 14: Maharashtra skipper Prithvi Shaw, who is looking to revive his career, failed to live up to the expectations as his side lost to Puducherry by 15 runs in their opening Group C match of the Syed Mushtaq Ali T20 Trophy here on Saturday.
Sent in to bat, Puducherry rode on vital contributions from opener Bhanu Anand (46 off 27 balls), Parameeswaran Sivaraman (46 off 21 balls) and Pugazhendi Akash (42 off 14 balls) to post a challenging 204 for nine.For Maharashtra, Vicky Ostwal (2/23), Mukesh Choudhary (2/27) and Prasanth Solanki (2/36) shared six wickets among them. Chasing 205, Maharashtra made a bright start with Shaw (32 off 25 balls) and Arshin Kulkarni (33 off 18 balls) stitching 44 runs in 4.4 overs.
Shaw and Sahil Parikh (57 off 29 balls) then shared 71 runs for the second wicket off 40 balls to keep Maharashtra afloat.But two wickets in the form of Shaw and Ramakrishna Ghosh within a span of two balls in the 14th over derailed their chase.
Rahul Tripathi (35 off 27 balls) tried his best but didn’t get the desired support from the other end despite having plenty of wickets in hand as Maharashtra suffered their first defeat in the tournament.
 Andhra beat Tripura by 43 runs 
 In another Group C match, Andhra dished out a clinical bowling display to register a 43-run win over Tripura in Mullanpur.Sent in to bat, Andhra posted a modest 141 for nine. (PTI)
